items.headline: Georgia Hall on Motherhood
items.text: Georgia Hall has returned to competitive golf 12 weeks after giving birth but expects to regain full strength by October due to lingering knee issues and muscle loss from pregnancy.

items.headline: Ernie Els Redesigns Portugal Course
items.text: Ernie Els revamped Portugal's Dom Pedro Victoria into The Els Club Vilamoura for the inaugural PGA Tour Champions Portugal Invitational, the senior tour's first event in Portugal and Europe.
